summary_en: 6,610,000 shares (24.4% of shares outstanding ex-treasury) to be acquired via ToSTNeT-3 on 30-Jul-26 at reference price ¥757/share, aggregate commitment ¥5,003.8M. Shares to be cancelled on 31-Aug-26. Method: off-hours single-day ToSTNeT-3 block at benchmark rate.
title_en: Notice of acquisition of treasury shares and purchase of treasury shares via off-hours trading (ToSTNeT-3), and cancellation of treasury shares
translation_en_brief: On 29-Jul-26, the board of Simplex Financial Holdings resolved to acquire 6,610,000 treasury shares (24.4% of shares outstanding, excluding treasury) via off-hours trading and to cancel those shares. The acquisition will occur on 30-Jul-26 via a single ToSTNeT-3 block trade at the reference price of ¥757 per share, with a total commitment of ¥5,003.8M (an upper limit). The company will place a buy order for the morning session only; no change to other trading systems or hours is made. The shares will be cancelled on 31-Aug-26. The stated rationale is to enable flexible capital allocation in response to changing business conditions and to effect shareholder returns, in accordance with the bylaws.
